name: Martins World
author: Galaxus team
description: A short campaign at Martins World, a tech works in the outer realms run by Martin, an engineer who will not give dates. The League of Time, pirates who think they are a sales team, have sold everything Martin makes, including things he hasn't invented yet, and want timescales. Fly with Martins World's few but formidable fighters, take Tally the robot's mining contract, and buy computer equipment cheap.
